title: Reason and response
subtitle: Read γάρ, οὖν, and ὅτι inside Gospel argument.
overview: Jesus’ speeches and narrative explanations often link a claim to a reason or a response. Mark these links before interpreting the statement.
A connector does not eliminate ambiguity, but it prevents isolated verse-by-verse reading.

items.grc: οὐ γὰρ ἦν ἐν αὐτοῖς πίστις.
items.en: For there was not faith in them.

items.grc: εἶπεν οὖν πρὸς αὐτούς· μὴ φοβεῖσθε.
items.en: Then / therefore he said to them, “Do not fear.”
